'''Steepara seeds''' were a food that formed a part of the [[Dressellian/Legends|Dressellian]] diet. Like most of the rest of the Dressellians' foods, the seeds were provided by [[Dressel/Legends|Dressel's]] [[steepara tree]]s.<ref name="Stay on Target" />
